description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace. It provides fluent configuration methods for services, options, configuration binding, and logging, to be used during silo setup in Orleans-based applications.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure services, options, and logging.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds user-defined service configurations to the ISiloBuilder, enabling chaining.

methods.name: Configure<TOptions>
methods.description: Configures options of type TOptions for the ISiloBuilder using a delegate.

methods.name: Configure<TOptions>
methods.description: Binds an IConfiguration instance to options of type TOptions for the ISiloBuilder.

methods.name: ConfigureLogging
methods.description: Adds logging configuration to the ISiloBuilder via a delegate, enabling chaining.
